leads.title: Looksmaxxing influencer Clavicular charged with rape of minor
leads.thesis: Braden Peters (Clavicular), face of looksmaxxing subculture, charged in Massachusetts with rape of 17-year-old after allegedly plying her with alcohol; tests how platforms handle misogynist fitness-influencer to criminal pipeline.

leads.title: White House launches 'Trump TV' 24/7 YouTube after barring major outlets
leads.thesis: Days after barring three major news outlets, White House launches round-the-clock YouTube channel promising direct feed; a state-media move that bypasses press corps and tests First Amendment norms.

leads.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI breach and employee data theft
leads.thesis: Extortion group ShinyHunters claims breach of FBI systems and theft of employee data; if verified, would be rare direct compromise of US law enforcement HR/intranet.

leads.title: White House says 760,000 Obamacare accounts fraudulent
leads.thesis: Administration flags 760k+ ACA marketplace accounts as fraudulent in new crackdown; claim could justify verification purge, coverage losses, and pre-midterm health care fight.

leads.title: Man shot by ICE in Austin alleges denial of medical care in detention
leads.thesis: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, shot by ICE agent in Austin, remains in detention with lawyer alleging inadequate care; raises use-of-force and detention medical standards questions.

leads.title: Grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells death on Mississippi island
leads.thesis: Grand jury declines to indict in July 4 death of Black teen Nolan Wells on Mississippi Gulf island; family questions racial bias as questions remain over investigation.

leads.title: Russia says EU plotting to move frozen assets out of Euroclear Belgium
leads.thesis: Russian foreign intelligence claims Brussels has new scheme to seize/move ~$300bn frozen Russian assets held at Belgium's Euroclear; Belgium's De Wever government is pivotal veto point.

leads.title: Trump backs idea of diesel export ban as Ukraine hits Russian refineries
leads.thesis: Trump says he backs diesel export ban while discussing Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries; links US energy protectionism to widening global refining crisis flagged by Chinese press.

leads.title: Houthi mountain offensive to cut Red Sea coast and Europe's dilemma
leads.thesis: Houthis push for key Yemen mountain positions to sever Red Sea coast from government territory as ECFR warns Europe lacks Red Sea strategy; mountain war directly threatens shipping lane.

leads.title: Trump called off Houthi strikes as bombs being loaded - report
leads.thesis: Daily Caller reports Trump aborted planned Houthi strikes at last minute while ordnance was being loaded; suggests restraint or deal-making amid Red Sea escalation.

leads.title: Trump at UN threatens to 'annihilate' Iran as Iran war spreads
leads.thesis: Trump's UNGA speech threatens to annihilate Iran and attacks ICC, while DW reports Iran war spreading regionally and markets price Strait of Hormuz and oil pipeline risks.

leads.title: Zelensky-Trump energy truce talk and pressure for ceasefire at UNGA
leads.thesis: Zelensky tells Trump Ukraine ready for energy truce with Russia as reports say Trump will press Zelensky to sign ceasefire at UN summit; energy infrastructure pause as possible off-ramp.

leads.title: Trump's India-Pakistan mediation claim: 'saved 30 million lives'
leads.thesis: At UNGA, Trump praises Pakistan PM Shehbaz as 'terrific man' and repeats claim he stopped India-Pakistan war and saved 30 million lives; India co-sponsors multilateralism summit in response.

leads.title: Gaza at UNGA: Board of Peace, Erdogan 'genocidal mindset' charge, and Eurovision boycott
leads.thesis: Ahead of UNGA, Board of Peace reiterates Gaza objectives while Erdogan blasts Israel's 'genocidal mindset' and Ireland again boycotts Eurovision over Gaza killings; cultural and diplomatic pressure converge.

leads.title: Netanyahu vs Mamdani feud erupts before UNGA
leads.thesis: Netanyahu vows to 'tell the truth' about NYC mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani as clash escalates; Israeli PM inserting into US urban race signals diaspora politics spillover.

leads.title: US ties Sudanese army chief's UN visa to ceasefire plan
leads.thesis: Sources say US conditioned visa for Sudanese army leader to attend UNGA on acceptance of ceasefire plan; visa leverage as peacemaking tool in Sudan's civil war.

leads.title: US seeks Belarus potash deal cheaper than Canada
leads.thesis: Trump says US working on deal to buy Belarus potash at lower price than Canada; would undercut top supplier Canada and ease sanctions on Lukashenko ally.

leads.title: Sanctions evasion watch: Russian gold via Hong Kong and Swiss push to lift sanctions
leads.thesis: Reports detail Russian gold routed through Hong Kong to dodge Western sanctions as Swiss billionaire lobbies to overturn Putin sanctions and EU ambassadors debate extension; cat-and-mouse of enforcement.

leads.title: Putin to attend Xi's APEC, skip G20 with Trump
leads.thesis: Putin plans to attend Xi-hosted APEC summit while skipping G20 where Trump expected; signals Sino-Russian alignment and avoidance of confrontation.

leads.title: France budget 2027 and fuel relief: growth, debt, deficit, jobs under strain
leads.thesis: Franceinfo lays out 2027 budget picture (growth, debt, deficit, unemployment) as government scales up targeted fuel price relief; fiscal tightening meets cost-of-living politics.

leads.title: Fed split: Iran war pushes official toward hike as markets bet on hold
leads.thesis: Fed official says Iran war pushed her toward supporting rate hike, contrasting with market pricing of no change in October and 'super central bank week' of global decisions.

leads.title: US threatens comprehensive ICC sanctions - what it would mean
leads.thesis: Hong Kong analysis examines impact if US imposes comprehensive sanctions on International Criminal Court after Trump's UN attack; could cripple investigations and split allies.

leads.title: Ceuta flashpoint: Morocco's strategic reconfiguration and border surge alert
leads.thesis: Eurasia Review links Ceuta enclave to Morocco's shift toward US-Israeli triangle as Africanews reports Ceuta on alert for new border surge; Spanish enclave as pressure valve.

leads.title: Trump renames AI 'super intelligence' and US superintelligence strategy debate
leads.thesis: Trump claims US will officially rename AI to 'super intelligence' as Import AI dissects US superintelligence strategy; branding meets industrial policy.

leads.title: AI funding and model sprint: Snorkel $3.5B, Anthropic Opus 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Live
leads.thesis: Snorkel AI triples to $3.5B on training data demand while Anthropic drops Opus 5.5 with lower prices and DeepMind launches Gemini 3.8 Live; data and inference price war intensifies.

leads.title: AI security double hit: Microsoft disrupts AI-assisted crime platform, Meta patches Muse 0-day
leads.thesis: Microsoft takes down AI-assisted platform that compromised 12,000 victims while Meta patches critical Muse agent 0-day that allowed attacker control; AI as both weapon and target.

leads.title: Rat-brain AI models and WorldCrafter 3D video world model
leads.thesis: Wired reports rat-brain-derived AI models nearing reality as arXiv's WorldCrafter offers consistent video world model with implicit 3D memory; bio-inspired and world-model paths converge.

leads.title: Corals show vaccine-like immune memory after pathogen exposure
leads.thesis: Phys.org reports corals exhibit vaccine-like responses after pathogen exposure, suggesting immune priming in reef builders; could inform reef restoration amid warming.

leads.title: Fire amoeba from Cascades sets record for hottest complex life
leads.thesis: Live Science/NASA-funded work finds 'fire amoeba' in Cascades surviving record heat, redefining upper thermal limit for complex (eukaryotic) life.

leads.title: Stronger concrete that pulls CO2 from air
leads.thesis: ScienceDaily reports new concrete formulation that is stronger while capturing CO2; addresses cement's ~8% of global emissions.

leads.title: 390-million-year-old impact crater found via satellite circle
leads.thesis: Strange circle on satellite maps turns out to be 390-million-year-old impact crater; discovery highlights how remote sensing rewrites impact record.

leads.title: Ancient anti-vampire grave used two strategies to stop the undead
leads.thesis: Science News reports ancient grave with dual anti-vampiric measures to prevent reanimation; reveals folk epidemiology of fear.

leads.title: Jumping genes as partners in evolution
leads.thesis: Quanta Magazine explains how virus-like transposons became co-opted as evolutionary partners, shaping mammalian genomes and development.

leads.title: Typhoon Dujuan triggers multiple fatal landslides in Japan
leads.thesis: Eos reports multiple fatal landslides from Typhoon Dujuan in Japan; highlights compound typhoon-landslide risk in steep terrain.

leads.title: Nepal floods: $20m loss-and-damage claim covers 0.7% of costs and climate justice demand
leads.thesis: Carbon Brief finds Nepal's $20m loss-and-damage claim covers just 0.7% of flood costs as minister demands climate justice and Nature calls for global climate-risk intelligence safety net.

leads.title: Multi-cancer early detection test PATHFINDER 2 results
leads.thesis: Nature Medicine publishes PATHFINDER 2 performance and safety data for multi-cancer early detection blood test; key test of screening promise vs overdiagnosis.

leads.title: Learning another language may be best brain health protector
leads.thesis: Ars Technica reports evidence that bilingualism/learning new language strongly protects brain health and delays cognitive decline.

leads.title: Europe's space autonomy push, Juice Earth flyby, and Sharp's Starlink challenger
leads.thesis: SpaceNews interviews ESA's Aschbacher on Europe's autonomy drive as ESA's Juice prepares third Earth gravity assist and Sharp unveils universal satellite antenna to challenge Starlink dominance.

leads.title: US Army tests 30mm AMPV with counter-drone and target-sharing
leads.thesis: Interesting Engineering reports US Army testing BAE AMPV with 30mm cannon, counter-drone systems and target-sharing; Bradley successor adapts to drone-saturated battlefield.

leads.title: Israel's first AI election flooded with fake divisive ads
leads.thesis: Japan Times reports Israel's election is first AI-driven contest, proliferating fake and divisive ads; tests platform and regulator response.

leads.title: NATO thumbs-up for AWS shows Europe still needs America - and US-China AI trust race
leads.thesis: Defense One notes NATO approval of AWS underscores Europe's continued dependence on US cloud as Rest of World argues America is in wrong AI race with China focused on trust not just scale.

leads.title: Macron's UN choice: UN over 'law of the jungle' and constructive Trump talks
leads.thesis: Macron urges world to choose UN over law of the jungle while calling his Trump talks on Red Sea and Ukraine constructive; French bid to keep multilateralism alive amid great-power deals.
